newsitem.title: LATVIA: UNIBANKA CUTS BASE LENDING RATE.
newsitem.headline: UNIBANKA CUTS BASE LENDING RATE.

text.p: Latvia's Unibanka said on Thursday it will cut its base annual lending rate from May 26.
The rate will fall to 14 to 21 percent from 15 to 24 percent, Unibanka said in a statement.

"The biggest cut by three percent refers to 10,000 lats or the foreign currency equivalent...a loan size mostly used by medium and small-sized companies as well as by individuals for consumption purposes," the bank said.
When considering business projects, risk factors would be considered, which could lead to a further lowering or rising of the rate.

The bank said the move would enhance the development of small and medium-size businesses in Latvia as it controlled one of the biggest loan portfolios in this country. The bank is Latvia's second largest in terms of assets.
The Commercial Bank Association's data shows Unibanka at the end of the first quarter had 66.1 million lats in loans.
